name: Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers
nodalDept: BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept., U.T. of DNH & DD
briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to construction workers facing permanent disability, chronic diseases, or requiring surgery/operations.
descriptionMd: The Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers scheme is a welfare initiative by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept., U.T. of DNH & DD. It aims to provide crucial financial support to eligible construction workers. This assistance covers expenses related to permanent disability, chronic diseases, or necessary surgeries and operations, ensuring workers receive aid during challenging health situations.
benefitsMd:
*   Financial assistance for permanent disability.
*   Financial assistance for chronic diseases.
*   Financial assistance for surgery or operation.
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be a construction worker.
*   Affected by permanent disability.
*   Suffering from chronic diseases.
*   Requiring surgery or an operation.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
